S02.meta: // SLIDE 02 — THE STAKES: the geometry threshold — localized cancer surgery can cure; disseminated cancer cannot be resected for cure

subject.label: Cancer spread at time of surgery

modes.label: Localized — confined to breast
modes.sub: all cancer in one anatomic place; surgery matches the problem's geometry
modes.resolves: curative resection — the intervention removes the disease

modes.label: Stage IV — distant metastases
modes.sub: liver metastases, distant spread — cancer is a systemic problem
modes.resolves: surgery addresses local control only; micrometastatic biology sets the ceiling

data.axisLabel: Curability — local geometry vs systemic spread
verdicts: Screening works by converting systemic problems into local ones surgery can solve
The operative field cannot remove what it cannot detect

S05.meta: // SLIDE 05 — SENTINEL NODE: the sentinel biopsy binary — negative inference spares dissection, positive shifts the clinical logic

branches.label: Sentinel node negative
branches.detail: Inference: entire nodal basin is clear. Operation is complete. No full axillary dissection required.
branches.fix: Full dissection spared — avoids lymphedema in 10–20% of patients who would otherwise develop it.

branches.label: Sentinel node positive
branches.detail: Inference: disease has reached the regional lymphatics. Clinical logic shifts — staging confirmed, therapeutic value reassessed.
branches.fix: Z0011 and AMAROS: completion dissection often adds morbidity without survival benefit in early breast cancer.

resolver.label: Staging value and therapeutic value must be established independently
resolver.detail: A positive node tells you something true about disease spread. Whether removing the basin extends survival is a separate empirical question.
